text: Explore career areas and jobs for you Saved jobs Create a job alert Search jobs Saved jobs Create a job alert Fraudulent Job Postings Beware of Hiring Scams: Hiring scams are a common tactic used by scammers to target individuals by impersonating someone who works at Target or posing as a recruitment agency. These fraudulent messages may be delivered through email, text message or social media platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed , Facebook or other networking sites . In some cases, individuals create fake social media profiles pretending to be Target recruiters. These messages often promote outdated or false job postings and may direct you to apply outside of our official careers site. The goal of these scams is typically to request “recruitment fees,” solicit payment or collect sensitive personal information. While Target recruiters may reach out through platforms like LinkedIn or job boards such as Indeed, here’s how you can verify you’re working with an official Target representative: Recruiter email communication will come from a @target.com email address . All open roles are posted on corporate.target.com/careers . Applications are submitted only through Workday, our official applicant tracking system . Target will never ask for payment, gift cards or banking information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, search the role directly on our careers site to confirm it’s legitimate. If you receive a suspicious recruiting message, report it on the platform where you received it — such as LinkedIn, iMessage, Indeed or Facebook. Want to receive job alerts? text: Skip to content Share the story Start for free Learn more Electricians often find themselves in a tough situation when trying to generate new business and develop effective marketing strategies. After all, you got into this trade to perform excellent, hands-on electrical work, not spend all day running a marketing department. However, the reality is that most of your customers search for electricians online and read their reviews before they ever call or book consultations. And if your competitors show up more prominently in online searches or have better reviews, you’ll lose the potential job before the phone even rings. Fortunately, digital marketing for electricians doesn’t have to be a complicated time-sink. A few fundamentals, done consistently, will help put your business in front of the right customers at the right moment so you can keep focusing on your current jobs and earn new business without spending hours every day managing your marketing efforts . Your website is your best sales vehicle. If it’s not converting visitors into calls, all of your other marketing efforts are effectively working against you. A solid Google Business Profile and local SEO are the highest-ROI free tools available to electrical contractors. Most electricians under-utilize both. Online reviews win you jobs before you ever pick up the phone. A consistent strategy for generating and responding to feedback compounds these benefits over time. Paid ads generate leads the same day and can be worth the cost, depending on your situation. Local SEO and content marketing build momentum over months. Digital marketing is everything you do online to help customers find you, trust you, contact you, and provide feedback for your business. This includes website optimization, local SEO, content marketing , social media, online reputation management, and paid advertising as appropriate. However, unlike large, nationwide brands, electricians and electrical contractors primarily compete with other local businesses. So you’re not necessarily going to focus as much on brand-building or name recognition as you would if you were a larger national enterprise. Instead, your goal is to be the first name that appears when someone in your service area searches for help with electrical issues. Some people may outsource these efforts to a digital marketing agency for electricians, while others manage it in-house either themselves or using a trusted employee or family member. Either way, understanding the fundamentals of digital marketing helps you make better decisions and earn more business. If interested, learn more about marketing segmentation and understanding your target audience . This is one area where many electricians feel inadequate to the task or just do what they consider the bare minimum. Sadly, most electricians’ websites are essentially digital business cards: they tell website visitors that you exist but don’t give people any compelling reason to choose you over your local competitors. This point is absolutely key: your website is where all your other marketing efforts are going to send people, so it’s vital that you get it right. There are plenty of do-it-yourself or AI-assisted website builders available for free or at a moderate cost, depending on features and complexity, but if you’re overwhelmed it can be worth it to enlist the help of a good website developer/designer familiar with the needs of small businesses. Regardless of how you choose to get it done, here’s what a high-converting electrical contractor website actually needs: A clear headline that states what you do and where (not just your company name). A clickable phone number “above the fold” (in the portion of your main webpage that’s visible on the screen before the user scrolls down) — this is the #1 action you want people to take on mobile. Trust signals: Include all relevant trust-building information you can provide, including your license number, insurance badge, years in business, service area, specializations, quotes of good reviews, etc. Consider separate landing/service pages for each type of work you offer (this will be covered more in depth in the SEO section below). A simple contact form or online booking option. Response time promise (this increases conversion rates significantly, but make sure you can stick to your word). Consider live chat for visitors who don’t feel comfortable talking on the phone, but will have typewritten/text-based interactions — this is increasingly common among younger customers. Mobile-first design: the majority of emergency electrical searches happen via mobile, where a slow or hard-to-navigate site loses the potential lead before a word is read. Make sure your website is fully optimized for a mobile viewing and customer experience. headings: Take time for you, when you need it
text: Benefits and Stock The perks of being an Amazon employee don’t stop at collaborating with great people on exciting and innovative projects. Amazon benefits support the needs of our diverse workforce and their family members, no matter what stage they’re at in their life or career. Depending on your location, country, job status, and other factors, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you. Coverage, growth, and ownership Stay healthy and financially fit Amazon provides you and your family access to the medical care you need, and ways to save for the future. Be ready for the unexpected We know you can’t prepare for every scenario, which is why Amazon provides comprehensive coverage and protection to handle life’s unexpected accidents and surprises. Take time for you, when you need it Regular time away from work is essential to recharge and renew. Employees accrue paid time off in addition to company paid holidays. And when you need more time for some of life’s bigger moments, such as caring for a new child or an ill family member, Amazon offers several paid and unpaid leave options. Grow professionally Amazon employees are encouraged to enter different roles, take on new challenges, and learn new skills. Our internal transfer opportunities and career development programs help employees build their careers. Get support when life gets complicated The Employee Assistance Program is available to employees and their families for work-related or private issues, including anxiety and stress, legal or financial questions, family issues, child or elder care referrals, and many other topics that are important to you. Take ownership At Amazon, most employees have the ability to become owners of the company through the granting and vesting of Restricted Stock Units. Amazon is continually evaluating ways to provide other types of ownership opportunities for all employees.

Learning pathways are specifically designed to provide the foundational knowledge needed for these exams. A plumbing company with steady review activity and detailed customer feedback typically performs better than one with an outdated or inactive profile. Google Business Profile posts can also help keep listings active. The Salesforce ecosystem supports millions of jobs globally — roles are accessible even without a tech background. Explore Salesforce Career Paths. Do I need a tech background to get started? No, you don't need a tech background. Many roles like the Administrator or Business Analyst often do not require a background in tech. Is Salesforce only for big companies? Not at all, companies of every size and industry use it. What are Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs? Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs are structured training run by Trailblazer Workforce Partner organisations such as non-profit organisations and training companies to help people gain Salesforce skills and find jobs. Which organizations run Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs? They are run by Trailblazer Workforce Partner Organisations , official Salesforce training organizations that deliver expert-led learning to help anyone build Agentforce, data, and CRM skills and launch careers in the Salesforce ecosystem. Self-paced learning vs. Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs: what's the difference? Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs offer structure, instructor-led classes, mentorship, career coaching, and community. Are there free Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs available? Yes, many non-profit partners offer fully free programs. Explore the Trailblazer Workforce Partner Directory to discover programs offered by our partners. What do paid Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs typically offer? Paid Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs typically offer more intensive training, 1:1 mentorship, accelerated timelines, and stronger employer connections. How do I find a local or virtual program? Many programs are fully online and global, while others have more locally-oriented training offerings. You can select programs based on your preferences by browsing the Trailblazer Workforce Partner Directory . What is a Salesforce certification? Salesforce certifications are official, industry-recognised credentials that prove your skills to employers. View all certifications. Do I need a Salesforce certification to get a job in the ecosystem? While having a Salesforce certification does not guarantee a job, it significantly boosts your chances, especially as a someone new to the Salesforce ecosystem. How much do Salesforce certifications cost? Most Salesforce exams cost around $200 USD. Some Trailblazer Workforce Partner Programs may offer exam vouchers.
